entities.name: Juan de las Cabezas Altamirano
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan de las Cabezas Altamirano was a Roman Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of Arequipa (1615), Bishop of Santiago de Guatemala (1610–1615), and Bishop of Santiago de Cuba (1602–1610).
